profile.headline: Software Developer at ParkHub
profile.summary: Currently working at ParkHub as a Mobile App Developer. Has experience developing mobile applications for the iOS platform, some of which are currently in the app store. Enjoys learning new technologies, and sharing knowledge with others.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description: Skills: Git · Kotlin · iOS Development · Android

positions.title: Software Developer Internship
positions.description:
Part of the iOS development team contributing to the flagship product Prime

Configured continuous integration through the CircleCI service

Improved Mobile Device Management configuration for Meraki Systems Manager

positions.title: Software Developer Internship
positions.description:
In the Language Software Development Department, in tandem with the Bloom team

Helped write a tool to convert old project formats into the Bloom format

Submitted bug fixes and features for the website (Javascript, Node, Angular)

positions.title: Software Development Intern
positions.description:
On the iOS development team, contributing to the various iOS applications

Headed the initial development of the Atlas feature for the mobile Logos App, fetching tiles from the server and building a scrollable map

Worked on cross-platform projects with Xamarin

positions.title: iOS App Developer
positions.description:
Worked on the following iOS apps in the Apple App Store:

In cooperation with Fresco Interactive:
- Countdown 2014
http://www.appstore.com/countdown2014

In cooperation with Del Brown:
- Philosopher’s Game (now at version 1.2, updated Nov. 10, 2012)
http://www.appstore.com/philosophersgame

For iWorksLLC
- iTourMobile (version 1.4, updated May 20, 2013)
http://www.appstore.com/itourmobile

For BookBottles LLC:
- BookBottles (v1.0 - v3.7, 5/26/15)
http://www.appstore.com/bookbottles

honors.title: Eagle Scout
honors.issuer: Issued by Boy Scouts of America · Sep 2012

organizations.name: Association of Computing Machinery
organizations.position: LeTourneau University Chapter President 2016-2017 · Sep 2014 - Present
